scripts.dev: npm run sandbox:up && concurrently -n client,api,ws,worker,studio,sbx -c cyan,magenta,green,blue,yellow,red "npm:dev --workspace=client" "npm:dev --workspace=@mockmatch/api" "npm:dev:ws --workspace=@mockmatch/api" "npm:dev:worker --workspace=@mockmatch/api" "npm:db:studio --workspace=@mockmatch/api" "npm run dev:sandbox-orchestrator --workspace=@mockmatch/api"
scripts.sandbox:install-gvisor: docker compose -f infra/sandbox/docker-compose.gvisor.yml run --rm runsc-installer && docker info
scripts.sandbox:shell: docker compose -f infra/sandbox/docker-compose.yml --profile manual run --rm --entrypoint jail-run sandbox -- bash -l
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@mockmatch/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
scripts.fallow: fallow dead-code && fallow dupes && fallow health --report-only
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run fallow:audit
